svg.aria-label: 5G9 · EYELET BOARD LAYOUT — redrawn board layout diagram, layout-sheet drafting style
svg.text: Redrawn from Fender 'Tremolux' Model 5G9 drawing (B-EI) — the factory LAYOUT page (page 1 of the el34world copy; the schematic page is the one redrawn in this amp's schematic.kicad_sch). This board order is read from that layout page, not derived from the schematic. Read at its native 6518 x 4128 raster (701 ppi) via the
Wayback Machine, el34world.com being unreachable — not a trace
Note: the 6.3 V heater twisted pair always routes on the top layer and never joins another run — its crossings are not hop-overs.
